meta.name: deployment-procedures
meta.description: Production deployment principles and decision-making. Safe deployment workflows, rollback strategies, and verification. Teaches thinking, not scripts.

copy.tagline: 掌握安全上线与回滚的决策方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责生产发布但不确定如何稳妥回滚
copy.tagline_en: Learn to plan safe production deployments and rollbacks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own production releases and worry about safe rollbacks.

howto.what: Claude 会按安全部署原则指导你上线：先根据平台类型选流程，对照检查清单核对测试、构建、环境与备份，再按准备—备份—部署—验证—确认/回滚五阶段执行，部署后检查健康、日志、关键流程，出故障时建议回滚或应急处理。
howto.when: 当你想把网站或服务发布到线上，或询问部署流程、回滚方案、平台选择时，Claude 会按这套原则给出决策建议。

say.text: 我要上线新版本，先帮我过一遍部署前检查清单。
say.note: Claude 会逐项核对测试、构建、环境变量等准备情况。

say.text: 如果发布后服务出错，该怎么回滚？
say.note: Claude 会根据你的平台说明回滚步骤。

say.text: 静态博客放在 Vercel 上，部署要注意什么？
say.note: Claude 会讲清该平台的部署与验证要点。

howto.what_en: Claude guides production releases: platform-specific workflow, pre-deploy checklist, five phases (prepare, backup, deploy, verify, confirm/rollback), post-deploy checks, rollback and emergency guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about deploying to production, choosing a platform, planning a release, or handling rollback/emergency during deployment.

say_en.text: I'm launching a new version. Walk me through the pre-deploy checklist.
say_en.note: Claude checks tests, build, env vars, and safety items.

say_en.text: If things break after release, how do I roll back?
say_en.note: Claude explains rollback steps for your platform.

say_en.text: What should I watch when deploying a static site to Vercel?
say_en.note: Claude covers deploy and verify steps for Vercel.
